h1. Section 9: FlatList and SectionList - Displaying Lists

Displaying lists of data is a common requirement in mobile apps. While {{<ScrollView>}} can display a list of items, it renders all items at once, which is inefficient for long lists. React Native provides two specialized list components, {{<FlatList>}} and {{<SectionList>}}, that offer better performance through virtualization (rendering only items currently visible or about to become visible).

h2. Conceptual Content: Understanding {{<FlatList>}} and {{<SectionList>}}

*{{<FlatList>}} Component:*

{{<FlatList>}} is designed for rendering simple, flat lists of data. It's highly performant for long lists because it only renders the items that are currently on screen (or nearby) and recycles list items as you scroll.

*Key Characteristics of {{<FlatList>}}:*

h2. Performant for Long Lists

Uses virtualization to render only visible items.
h2. Flat Data Structure

Expects a simple array of data items.
h2. {{renderItem}} Prop

Requires a function ({{renderItem}}) that takes an item from your data array and returns a React component to render for that item.
h2. {{keyExtractor}} Prop

Requires a function ({{keyExtractor}}) that returns a unique key for each item. This is crucial for React to manage list items efficiently during updates.
h2. Built-in Features

Supports features like pull-to-refresh, scroll loading (infinite scroll), separators between items, and header/footer components.
h2. Optimization

Provides props like {{initialNumToRender}}, {{maxToRenderPerBatch}}, {{windowSize}} to fine-tune rendering performance.

*{{<SectionList>}} Component:*

{{<SectionList>}} is similar to {{<FlatList>}} but is designed for rendering lists that are broken into logical sections, like a contacts list grouped by letter or a menu grouped by category.

*Key Characteristics of {{<SectionList>}}:*

h2. Performant for Sectioned Lists

Also uses virtualization.
h2. Sectioned Data Structure

Expects data in a specific format: an array of section objects, where each section object has a {{title}} (or some identifier for the section header) and a {{data}} array (the items within that section).
h2. {{renderItem}} Prop

Similar to {{<FlatList>}}, defines how to render each item within a section.
h2. {{renderSectionHeader}} Prop

Requires a function that takes a section object and returns a React component to render as the header for that section.
h2. {{keyExtractor}} Prop

Used for items, similar to {{<FlatList>}}.
h2. Sticky Section Headers

By default, section headers stick to the top of the screen as you scroll through the items in that section (this can be configured).

*When to Use Which:*
* Use {{<ScrollView>}} when:
** You have a small, finite number of items that won't cause performance issues.
** The content is heterogeneous and not necessarily a "list" of data (e.g., a form with various input types, text blocks, and images).
* Use {{<FlatList>}} when:
** You have a long, simple list of data items (e.g., a list of search results, a list of messages).
** Performance is a concern for rendering many items.
* Use {{<SectionList>}} when:
** You need to display a list grouped into sections with headers (e.g., a settings page, a grouped directory).

For the SpeedyMeds app, {{<FlatList>}} could be used to display a list of available medications or a patient's order history. {{<SectionList>}} could be used to display a formulary grouped by drug class or a patient's medication schedule grouped by time of day.

bq. 📲 *(Native Developers):*
> *Comparison:*
> - {{<FlatList>}} and {{<SectionList>}} are analogous to {{UITableView}} (iOS) or {{RecyclerView}} (Android). They provide efficient ways to display large, scrollable lists of data by recycling views (or components in React Native's case) and only rendering what's necessary.
> *Key Takeaway:* These are your go-to components for displaying lists of data, offering performance benefits over {{<ScrollView>}} for large datasets.
> *Source:* [https://reactnative.dev/docs/flatlist|React Native Docs: FlatList], [https://reactnative.dev/docs/sectionlist|React Native Docs: SectionList]

bq. 🌐 *(Web Developers):*
> *Comparison:* {{<FlatList>}} and {{<SectionList>}} provide functionality similar to virtualized list libraries on the web (e.g., {{react-window}} or {{react-virtualized}}). They address the performance issues of rendering a very large number of DOM elements by only rendering what's visible.
> *Key Takeaway:* For lists, especially long ones, these components are essential for good performance, unlike simply mapping over an array to create many elements within a scrollable {{<div>}} which can be slow.

h2. Referential Content: Common Props

*Common {{<FlatList>}} Props:*
* {{data}}: (array, *required*) The array of data items for the list.
* {{renderItem}}: (function, *required*) Function that returns a React component for each item. Receives an object with {{item}}, {{index}}, and {{separators}}.
** _Signature:_ {{({ item: ItemT, index: number, separators: { highlight: () => void, unhighlight: () => void, updateProps: (select: 'leading' | 'trailing', newProps: any) => void }}) => React.ReactElement | null}}
* {{keyExtractor}}: (function, *required*) Function that returns a unique string key for a given item.
** _Signature:_ {{(item: ItemT, index: number) => string}}
* {{ItemSeparatorComponent}}: (ComponentType | React.ReactElement | null) Component rendered between each item, but not at the top or bottom.
* {{ListHeaderComponent}}: (ComponentType | React.ReactElement | null) Rendered at the top of the list.
* {{ListFooterComponent}}: (ComponentType | React.ReactElement | null) Rendered at the bottom of the list.
* {{ListEmptyComponent}}: (ComponentType | React.ReactElement | null) Rendered when the {{data}} array is empty.
* {{onEndReached}}: (function) Called once when the scroll position gets within {{onEndReachedThreshold}} of the rendered content.
* {{onEndReachedThreshold}}: (number) How far from the end (in units of visible length of the list) the bottom edge of the list must be from the end of the content to trigger the {{onEndReached}} callback. Thus, a value of 0.5 will trigger {{onEndReached}} when the end of the content is within half the visible length of the list.
* {{refreshing}}: (boolean) Set to true while waiting for new data from a refresh.
* {{onRefresh}}: (function) If provided, a standard {{RefreshControl}} will be added for "Pull to Refresh" functionality.

*Common {{<SectionList>}} Props:*
* {{sections}}: (array, *required*) The array of section objects.
** _Section Object Shape:_ {{{ title: string, data: ItemT[], [key: string]: any }}} (You can add other properties to your section object, e.g., a section ID).
* {{renderItem}}: (function, *required*) Renders each item in a section. Receives an object with {{item}}, {{index}}, {{section}}, and {{separators}}.
** _Signature:_ {{({ item: ItemT, index: number, section: SectionT, separators: {...} }) => React.ReactElement | null}}
* {{renderSectionHeader}}: (function, *required*) Renders the header for each section. Receives an object with {{section}}.
** _Signature:_ {{({ section: SectionT }) => React.ReactElement | null}}
* {{keyExtractor}}: (function, *required*) Returns a unique key for a given item. Typically {{(item, index) => item.id || index.toString()}}.
* {{stickySectionHeadersEnabled}}: (boolean) Makes section headers stick to the top of the screen until the next one pushes it off. Default is {{true}} on iOS, {{false}} on Android.
* (Many props similar to {{<FlatList>}} like {{ListHeaderComponent}}, {{ListFooterComponent}}, {{onRefresh}}, {{refreshing}} also apply).

bq. 📚 *Official Documentation:*
> - [https://reactnative.dev/docs/flatlist#props|React Native Docs: FlatList Props]
- [https://reactnative.dev/docs/sectionlist#props|React Native Docs: SectionList Props]
- [https://docs.expo.dev/ui-programming/flatlist/|Expo Docs: FlatList]
- [https://docs.expo.dev/ui-programming/sectionlist/|Expo Docs: SectionList]

h2. Procedural Content: Basic Usage

*1. {{<FlatList>}} Example: SpeedyMeds Medication List*

{code:language=js}
import React, { useState, useCallback } from "react";
import {
  StyleSheet,
  SafeAreaView,
  FlatList,
  View,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  Alert,
  StatusBar,
} from "react-native";

interface Medication {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  dosage: string;
  stock: number;
}

const INITIAL_MEDICATIONS: Medication[] = [
  { id: "1", name: "Amoxicillin", dosage: "250mg", stock: 150 },
  { id: "2", name: "Lisinopril", dosage: "10mg", stock: 75 },
  { id: "3", name: "Metformin", dosage: "500mg", stock: 200 },
  { id: "4", name: "Atorvastatin", dosage: "20mg", stock: 120 },
  { id: "5", name: "Simvastatin", dosage: "40mg", stock: 90 },
  { id: "6", name: "Omeprazole", dosage: "20mg", stock: 60 },
  { id: "7", name: "Amlodipine", dosage: "5mg", stock: 180 },
  { id: "8", name: "Levothyroxine", dosage: "50mcg", stock: 50 },
  // Add more for a longer list to see virtualization
];

const MedicationItem = React.memo(
  ({ item, onPress }: { item: Medication; onPress: (id: string) => void }) => (
    <TouchableOpacity
      onPress={() => onPress(item.id)}
      style={styles.itemContainer}
    >
      <View style={styles.itemTextContainer}>
        <Text style={styles.itemName}>
          {item.name} <Text style={styles.itemDosage}>({item.dosage})</Text>
        </Text>
        <Text style={styles.itemStock}>In Stock: {item.stock}</Text>
      </View>
      <Text style={styles.itemActionIcon}>➡️</Text>
    </TouchableOpacity>
  )
);

export default function MedicationListScreen_FlatList() {
  const [medications, setMedications] = useState(INITIAL_MEDICATIONS);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);

  const handlePressItem = (id: string) => {
    const med = medications.find((m) => m.id === id);
    Alert.alert(
      "Medication Selected",
      `You selected ${med?.name || "Unknown"}`
    );
  };

  const onRefresh = useCallback(() => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    // Simulate fetching new data
    setTimeout(() => {
      const newMedications = [...INITIAL_MEDICATIONS].sort(
        () => 0.5 - Math.random()
      ); // Shuffle
      setMedications(newMedications);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }, 1500);
  }, []);

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safeArea}>
      <Text style={styles.listHeader}>Available Medications</Text>
      <FlatList
        data={medications}
        renderItem={({ item }) => (
          <MedicationItem item={item} onPress={handlePressItem} />
        )}
        keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
        ItemSeparatorComponent={() => <View style={styles.separator} />}
        ListEmptyComponent={
          <Text style={styles.emptyListText}>No medications found.</Text>
        }
        refreshing={refreshing}
        onRefresh={onRefresh}
        contentContainerStyle={styles.listContentContainer}
      />
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  safeArea: {
    flex: 1,
    marginTop: StatusBar.currentHeight || 0,
    backgroundColor: "#f0f8ff",
  },
  listHeader: {
    fontSize: 22,
    fontWeight: "bold",
    textAlign: "center",
    paddingVertical: 15,
    backgroundColor: "#e6f2ff",
    color: "#003366",
    borderBottomWidth: 1,
    borderBottomColor: "#cce0ff",
  },
  itemContainer: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    justifyContent: "space-between",
    alignItems: "center",
    paddingVertical: 15,
    paddingHorizontal: 20,
    backgroundColor: "#ffffff",
  },
  itemTextContainer: {
    flex: 1,
  },
  itemName: {
    fontSize: 18,
    fontWeight: "500",
    color: "#333",
  },
  itemDosage: {
    fontSize: 15,
    color: "#555",
  },
  itemStock: {
    fontSize: 14,
    color: "#006400", // Dark green for stock
    marginTop: 4,
  },
  itemActionIcon: {
    fontSize: 20,
    color: "#007bff",
  },
  separator: {
    height: 1,
    backgroundColor: "#e0e0e0",
    marginLeft: 20,
  },
  emptyListText: {
    textAlign: "center",
    marginTop: 50,
    fontSize: 18,
    color: "#888",
  },
  listContentContainer: {
    paddingBottom: 20, // Ensure last item is not cut off by tab bar etc.
  },
});
{code}

*Explanation of `<FlatList>` Example:*
* `data`: The `medications` array.
* `renderItem`: Returns a `MedicationItem` component for each medication. `MedicationItem` is memoized using `React.memo` for potential performance optimization, preventing re-renders if its props haven't changed.
* `keyExtractor`: Uses `item.id` as the unique key.
* `ItemSeparatorComponent`: Renders a simple `<View>` as a line separator.
* `onRefresh` and `refreshing`: Implements pull-to-refresh functionality.

*2. `<SectionList>` Example: SpeedyMeds Patient Medication Schedule*

{code:language=js}
import React from "react";
import {
  StyleSheet,
  SafeAreaView,
  SectionList,
  View,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  Alert,
  StatusBar,
} from "react-native";

interface MedicationScheduleItem {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  dosage: string;
  instructions: string;
}

interface ScheduleSection {
  title: string; // e.g., 'Morning', 'Afternoon', 'Evening'
  data: MedicationScheduleItem[];
}

const PATIENT_SCHEDULE: ScheduleSection[] = [
  {
    title: "Morning (8:00 AM)",
    data: [
      {
        id: "m1",
        name: "Lisinopril",
        dosage: "10mg",
        instructions: "Take with water",
      },
      {
        id: "m2",
        name: "Metformin",
        dosage: "500mg",
        instructions: "Take with breakfast",
      },
    ],
  },
  {
    title: "Afternoon (1:00 PM)",
    data: [
      {
        id: "a1",
        name: "Amoxicillin",
        dosage: "250mg",
        instructions: "Take after lunch, finish course",
      },
    ],
  },
  {
    title: "Evening (8:00 PM)",
    data: [
      {
        id: "e1",
        name: "Atorvastatin",
        dosage: "20mg",
        instructions: "Take before bed",
      },
      {
        id: "e2",
        name: "Metformin",
        dosage: "500mg",
        instructions: "Take with dinner",
      },
    ],
  },
  {
    title: "As Needed",
    data: [
      {
        id: "n1",
        name: "Ibuprofen",
        dosage: "200mg",
        instructions: "For pain, max 3 times/day",
      },
    ],
  },
];

const ScheduleItem = ({ item }: { item: MedicationScheduleItem }) => (
  <TouchableOpacity
    style={styles.scheduleItemContainer}
    onPress={() =>
      Alert.alert(item.name, `${item.dosage} - ${item.instructions}`)
    }
  >
    <Text style={styles.scheduleItemName}>
      {item.name} <Text style={styles.scheduleItemDosage}>({item.dosage})</Text>
    </Text>
    <Text style={styles.scheduleItemInstructions}>{item.instructions}</Text>
  </TouchableOpacity>
);

const SectionHeader = ({ title }: { title: string }) => (
  <View style={styles.sectionHeaderContainer}>
    <Text style={styles.sectionHeaderText}>{title}</Text>
  </View>
);

export default function PatientScheduleScreen_SectionList() {
  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safeArea}>
      <SectionList
        sections={PATIENT_SCHEDULE}
        keyExtractor={(item, index) => item.id + index} // Ensure unique keys
        renderItem={({ item }) => <ScheduleItem item={item} />}
        renderSectionHeader={({ section: { title } }) => (
          <SectionHeader title={title} />
        )}
        ItemSeparatorComponent={() => <View style={styles.itemSeparator} />}
        SectionSeparatorComponent={() => (
          <View style={styles.sectionSeparator} />
        )}
        stickySectionHeadersEnabled
        ListHeaderComponent={
          <Text style={styles.mainListHeader}>
            John Doe's Medication Schedule
          </Text>
        }
      />
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  safeArea: {
    flex: 1,
    marginTop: StatusBar.currentHeight || 0,
    backgroundColor: "#faf3e0", // Creamy background
  },
  mainListHeader: {
    fontSize: 22,
    fontWeight: "bold",
    textAlign: "center",
    paddingVertical: 15,
    backgroundColor: "#e4d8b4",
    color: "#5a3e2b", // Brownish color
  },
  sectionHeaderContainer: {
    backgroundColor: "#d3c0a0", // Lighter brown for section headers
    paddingVertical: 10,
    paddingHorizontal: 15,
  },
  sectionHeaderText: {
    fontSize: 18,
    fontWeight: "bold",
    color: "#402c1d",
  },
  scheduleItemContainer: {
    backgroundColor: "#fff8e7", // Very light cream for items
    paddingVertical: 12,
    paddingHorizontal: 15,
  },
  scheduleItemName: {
    fontSize: 16,
    fontWeight: "500",
    color: "#5d4037",
  },
  scheduleItemDosage: {
    fontSize: 14,
    color: "#795548",
  },
  scheduleItemInstructions: {
    fontSize: 14,
    color: "#8d6e63",
    marginTop: 3,
  },
  itemSeparator: {
    height: 1,
    backgroundColor: "#e0e0e0",
    marginLeft: 15,
  },
  sectionSeparator: {
    height: 8, // Thicker separator between sections
    backgroundColor: "#c1a87c",
  },
});
{code}

*Explanation of `<SectionList>` Example:*
* `sections`: The `PATIENT_SCHEDULE` array, where each object has a `title` and a `data` array.
* `renderItem`: Returns a `ScheduleItem` for each medication in a section.
* `renderSectionHeader`: Returns a `SectionHeader` for each section's title.
* `keyExtractor`: Uses `item.id + index` to ensure keys are unique across sections if item IDs might not be unique globally.
* `stickySectionHeadersEnabled`: Section headers will stick to the top when scrolling.

These examples demonstrate the power and flexibility of `<FlatList>` and `<SectionList>` for rendering various types of lists efficiently in applications like SpeedyMeds.
